'''Tendau Bendon''' was a [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] and the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Tendau Bendon represented the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]] in the Senate during [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] last term as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. Bendon was among the senators who openly supported Valorum, even if most of the Senate would have rather replace the Chancellor.<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Chancellor Valorum proposed the taxation of the until then free trade zones. Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] then suggested that a part of the collected money could be invested in the growth of planetary systems in the affected areas. Bendon and other senators of the region, including [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] and [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]], cheerfully supported the idea.<ref name="cod" />

Bendon continued his career as senator during the years which followed the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bendon was a staunch opponent of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. His attempts to oppose it were unsuccessful which led to the start of the Clone Wars.<ref name="HNN 46" />

==Personality and traits==
During his time on Coruscant, Bendon visited the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]], like many other politicians of the time. Bendon was known to have assisted to a representation of ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', performed by a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] company.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'' mistakenly identified an Ithorian merchant from [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] as Senator Bendon.<ref name="CVSD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
